name: Soul Calibur ~Inko Jutai~
original_name: ソオルキャリバー～淫児受胎～
source:
This is a gang bang and impregnation novel adventure game based on the 3D action game, "Soulcalibur."

Evil sword which causes the misfortune somewhere in the world ...
It starts its activity to search for the fighting maidens who have strong souls to impregnate them, as the desire demands him ...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE050398.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
这是一款以3D动作游戏《刀魂》为题材，以轮奸与受孕为主题的小说类冒险游戏。

给世界某处不断带来不幸的邪剑……
在欲望驱使下，它再度开始行动，寻找拥有强大灵魂的女战士，企图使她们怀孕……

[引自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE050398.html]DLsite英文站[/url]]
